about.title: About OAM
about.intro: One app for the everyday things Nigerians pay for, sell, and hire — built to be quick, honest, and safe with your money.
about.whatP1: OAM is a multi-service platform operated by <1>O.A.M Motors Limited</1>. It brings together the things most people currently juggle across half a dozen apps: topping up airtime, buying electricity units, paying for TV, sending money, selling something you no longer need, and finding a tradesperson you can trust.
about.whatP2: Everything runs through a single wallet, so you can see exactly what you've spent and what you're owed — and every purchase produces a receipt you can find again.

bills.title: Bills and utilities
bills.body: Airtime, data, electricity tokens and TV subscriptions, delivered in seconds and receipted by email.

wallet.title: Wallet and transfers
wallet.body: Fund by card, send to another OAM user instantly, or withdraw to your own bank account.

marketplace.title: Marketplace
marketplace.body: Buy and sell within the OAM community, with messaging built in so your phone number stays private.

services.title: Home services
services.body: Find verified plumbers, electricians, mechanics and cleaners near you.

travel.title: Travel
travel.body: Compare flights, hotels, car hire and airport pickups worldwide.

about.moneyP1: We think you should know this, because a service that hides its revenue model usually has a reason to.
about.moneyP2: On bills, we earn a <1>small margin</1> — typically ₦10 to ₦20 on a ₦1,000 purchase — built into the price you see. There is no separate fee added at checkout, and the amount you're shown is the amount you pay.
about.moneyP3: On the Marketplace and Home Services, we earn from <1>optional paid plans</1>: sellers can subscribe for more listings and featured placement, and artisans can boost their profile to appear higher in search. Listing and messaging are free.
about.moneyP4: On travel, we earn a <1>referral commission</1> from booking partners at no extra cost to you.
about.safetyP1: Phone numbers on the Marketplace and Home Services are <1>never published</1>. They're exchanged only once a seller or artisan accepts your enquiry — so nobody's number sits on a public page waiting to be harvested, and you only ever get the contact details of someone who has actually agreed to deal with you.
about.safetyP2: Payments are processed by <1>Paystack</1>. Card details are entered on Paystack's own secure checkout and are never seen or stored by OAM.
about.noteBody: <1>A note on where we are.</1> OAM is newly launched, so some sections — particularly the Marketplace and the artisan directory — are still filling up. Coverage grows as more people join, and we'd rather say so than pretend otherwise.

contact.title: Contact us
contact.intro: Something gone wrong, or a question before you start? Here's how to reach a person.
contact.emailBody: The fastest route for anything to do with a payment, a missing token, or an account problem.
contact.paymentTitle: If a payment has gone wrong
contact.paymentP1: <1>Please don't pay twice.</1> If an order shows as "processing", the money has already left and the purchase is with your provider — buying again usually means paying for the same thing a second time.
contact.paymentLi1: the <1>reference number</1> from the order (it starts with BILL-, FUND- or TRF-)
contact.paymentLi2: the email address on your OAM account
contact.paymentP2: That's usually enough for us to find the transaction and tell you exactly where it is. You can find the reference under <1>Order history</1>.
contact.mktTitle: Buying or selling on the Marketplace
contact.mktP1: Questions about a specific item or job are best asked <1>directly in the chat</1> attached to that listing or artisan profile — the other person gets notified, and there's a record of what was agreed.
contact.mktP2: Contact us instead if someone asks you to pay outside OAM, pressures you for money in advance, or behaves in a way that doesn't feel right. We'd rather hear about it early.
contact.responseBody: We aim to reply to every email within <1>one working day</1>. Payment problems are looked at first. If you haven't heard back after two working days, reply to your own email to bump it — it's more reliable than sending a new one.
contact.scamBody: <1>We will never ask for your password, card PIN, or a one-time code.</1> Anyone who does — by call, SMS or WhatsApp — is not from OAM, however convincing they sound. Hang up and email us instead.

help.title: Help centre
help.intro: Answers to the things people ask most — starting with the one that matters when money is involved.
help.noMatch: Nothing matches "{{query}}". Email <1>info@oam-app.com</1> and a person will answer.
help.stillStuck: Still stuck? Email <1>info@oam-app.com</1> with your order reference and we'll look it up. See <2>Contact</2> for what to include.

electricity.title: Electricity tokens
electricity.q1: I paid for units but no token appeared. What now?
electricity.a1p1: <1>Don't buy again.</1> Your payment has gone through and the order is with your provider — buying a second time charges you twice for the same meter.
electricity.a1p2: Open <1>Order history</1>. While an order is still completing you'll see "Token on the way", and the page checks with your provider every few seconds. Tokens usually arrive within a minute or two, occasionally longer at busy times.
electricity.a1p3: The token is also emailed to you as soon as it's issued, so you'll get it even if you've closed the app.
electricity.q2: Where can I find an old token?
electricity.a2: Every token is stored permanently in <1>Order history</1> — open the order and it's there with a copy button. It's also in the receipt email we sent at the time.
electricity.a3: Nigerian prepaid meters are <1>11 digits</1>. We only check with your disco once all 11 are entered, so a message while you're still typing just means we're waiting. If a complete number is still rejected, check you've picked the right disco — a valid meter on the wrong disco will always fail.

wallet.title: Wallet and payments
wallet.q1: Why does my card payment go into my wallet first?
wallet.a1p1: Card payments credit your wallet, and the wallet then pays for what you bought. It looks like an extra step, and it's deliberate.
wallet.a1p2: If a delivery fails, the money is already sitting safely in your wallet as a balance you can spend or withdraw. Paying a provider directly would leave your money stranded between the card processor and them, with no clean way back.
wallet.a2: No. The total shown before you pay is what you pay — the fee line reads ₦0 because there isn't one. Our margin is built into the price of bills, so nothing is added at checkout.
wallet.a3: Bank transfers usually land within minutes, though they can take longer during bank downtime. If a withdrawal fails, the amount is returned to your wallet automatically — it isn't lost, and you can try again.
wallet.q4: Can I send money to another OAM user?
wallet.a4: Yes — <1>Transfer</1> moves money between OAM wallets instantly and free. Enter their email or phone number and their name appears before you confirm. <2>Check that name carefully</2>: completed transfers can't be reversed.

marketplace.title: Marketplace and artisans
marketplace.q1: Why can't I see a seller's phone number?
marketplace.a1p1: Numbers are never published. Send a message about the item, and once the seller accepts, you'll both see each other's contact details.
marketplace.a1p2: It's slightly slower, and it's the single most effective protection we can offer: published numbers get scraped, and scraped numbers get used for impersonation scams.
marketplace.q2: How many things can I list for free?
marketplace.a2: Three active listings, indefinitely, with no card required. Premium (₦2,500) adds up to 20 listings plus featured placement, and Pro (₦5,000) is unlimited.
marketplace.q3: How do I stay safe buying and selling?
marketplace.a3li1: Meet in a public place during daylight
marketplace.a3li2: Inspect the item before any money changes hands
marketplace.a3li3: Never send money in advance to someone you haven't met
marketplace.a3li4: Keep the conversation in OAM, so there's a record of what was agreed
marketplace.a3li5: Treat any request to move to WhatsApp "for a better price" as a warning sign
marketplace.q4: What does boosting an artisan profile do?
marketplace.a4: It places your profile above unboosted ones in search results, where most people look. Premium is ₦2,500 for 30 days and Pro is ₦5,000 for 90. Both are <1>one-off payments</1> — nothing renews automatically.

account.title: Account
account.q1: Can I use the same account to buy and to sell?
account.a1: Yes. One account does everything — you might sell a fridge and hire a plumber in the same week. Your messages are split into "My enquiries" and "Enquiries to me" so the two don't get tangled.
account.q2: Is my card stored on OAM?
account.a2: No. Card details are entered on Paystack's secure checkout and are never seen or stored by us.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: What we collect, why, who else sees it, and what you can ask us to do about it.
privacy.controlBody: <1>O.A.M Motors Limited</1> (RC <2>[TO CONFIRM]</2>) is the data controller. For any privacy question or request, email <3>info@oam-app.com</3>.
privacy.giveLi1: Name, email address and phone number when you register
privacy.giveLi2: Bank account details when you set up a withdrawal
privacy.giveLi3: Meter numbers, smartcard numbers and phone numbers you pay bills for
privacy.giveLi4: Listing details, artisan profile details, and the contact numbers on them
privacy.giveLi5: Messages you send to other users through OAM
privacy.createdLi1: Wallet balance and full transaction history
privacy.createdLi2: Orders, references, and electricity tokens issued to you
privacy.createdLi3: Approximate location, if you allow it, to find artisans near you
privacy.collectCard: <1>We never see or store your card details.</1> Cards are entered on Paystack's own checkout and stay with them.
privacy.whyLi1: <1>To run your account and process payments</1> — we can't deliver airtime or units without the number or meter
privacy.whyLi2: <1>To send receipts and tokens</1> by email, so a delivered token isn't lost when you close the app
privacy.whyLi3: <1>To connect buyers and sellers</1> — contact details are released only when an enquiry is accepted
privacy.whyLi5: <1>To meet legal and regulatory obligations</1>, including financial record-keeping
privacy.whyNoSell: We do <1>not</1> sell your personal data, and we don't show advertising based on it.
privacy.whoIntro: Only what each partner needs to do their job:
privacy.whoLi1: <1>Paystack</1> — payments and withdrawals; they receive your name, email and payment details
privacy.whoLi2: <1>Bill providers</1> — the phone number, meter or smartcard number for that purchase
privacy.whoLi3: <1>Other OAM users</1> — your name and, once you accept an enquiry, your contact number
privacy.whoLi4: <1>Travel partners</1> — if you follow a booking link, their own privacy policy applies from that point
privacy.whoLi5: <1>Regulators or law enforcement</1> — where we're legally required to disclose
privacy.contactTitle: Contact details on listings and profiles
privacy.contactP1: The number on your listing or artisan profile is <1>not published publicly</1>. It's held privately and released to one specific person only when you accept their enquiry.
privacy.contactP2: This is deliberate: numbers on public pages get harvested and reused for impersonation scams. Keeping the release under your control is the single most useful protection we can offer, so it's built into the product rather than left as a setting.
privacy.keepP1: Account and transaction records are kept while your account is open, and for a period afterwards to meet financial record-keeping obligations. <1>[TO CONFIRM — the exact retention period should be set with advice; financial records in Nigeria are typically kept for several years.]</1>
privacy.keepP2: Messages between users are kept while both accounts remain open.
privacy.rightsIntro: Under the Nigeria Data Protection Act 2023 you can ask us to:
privacy.rightsLi1: show you the personal data we hold about you
privacy.rightsLi3: delete data we no longer have a lawful reason to keep
privacy.rightsLi4: stop using your data for a particular purpose
privacy.rightsLi5: provide your data in a portable form
privacy.rightsEmail: Email <1>info@oam-app.com</1>. We'll respond within one month.
privacy.rightsKeep: Some data we must keep even after you ask — completed financial transactions, for instance, where the law requires a record. We'll tell you if that applies.
privacy.securityP1: Passwords are stored hashed, never in readable form. Payments go through Paystack's secure checkout. Access to customer data inside OAM is limited to the people who need it to run the service.
privacy.securityP2: No system is perfectly secure. If a breach affects your data, we'll tell you and the regulator as the law requires.
privacy.changesBody: If we change this policy materially, we'll notify you by email or in the app before it takes effect. See also our <1>Terms of Service</1>.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: The agreement between you and O.A.M Motors Limited when you use OAM.
terms.s1Body: OAM is operated by <1>O.A.M Motors Limited</1>, a company registered in Nigeria (RC <2>[TO CONFIRM]</2>), registered address <3>[TO CONFIRM]</3>. In these terms "we", "us" and "OAM" mean that company; "you" means the account holder.
terms.s2P1: You must be <1>18 or over</1> and provide accurate details. One person, one account. You are responsible for keeping your password and one-time codes private — we will never ask you for them, and anyone who does is not from OAM.
terms.s2P2: Tell us immediately at <1>info@oam-app.com</1> if you believe someone else has access to your account.
terms.s3P1: Your wallet balance is money we hold for you. It is not a bank deposit, it earns no interest, and it is not covered by deposit insurance.
terms.s3P2: You can withdraw your balance to a bank account in your own name at any time, subject to the checks below. Card payments credit your wallet first and the wallet then pays for your purchase — so if a delivery fails, the money remains yours as a wallet balance.
terms.s3P3: <1>Transfers between OAM users are final.</1> Check the recipient's name, shown before you confirm, because a completed transfer cannot be reversed.
terms.s4P1: We buy these from licensed third-party providers on your instruction. The price you are shown is the price you pay; our margin is included in it and no separate fee is added.
terms.s4P2: <1>Check the recipient before you confirm.</1> Airtime sent to a mistyped number, or units sent to the wrong meter, generally cannot be recovered — the value has already been delivered to that number or meter.
terms.s4P3: Where a purchase fails at the provider, the amount is returned to your wallet. Where a provider is delayed, the order remains open until it settles; buying again during a delay means paying twice, and we cannot refund a duplicate purchase you chose to make.
terms.s5P1: <1>OAM is not a party to these deals.</1> We provide the listing and the messaging; the agreement is between buyer and seller, or customer and artisan. We do not verify items, inspect work, hold payment in escrow, or guarantee quality.
terms.s5P2: You are responsible for what you list, and for meeting your side of anything you agree. Contact details are exchanged only when a seller or artisan accepts an enquiry.
terms.s5ListIntro: You may not list, among other things:
terms.s5Li1: anything illegal to sell in Nigeria
terms.s5Li2: weapons, controlled drugs, or counterfeit goods
terms.s5Li3: stolen property, or anything you don't have the right to sell
terms.s5Li4: services you are not qualified or licensed to provide
terms.s5P3: We may remove listings and suspend accounts where these terms are broken. Paid plan fees are generally not refundable where an account is suspended for breach.
terms.s6P1: Seller subscriptions (Premium and Pro) and artisan boosts are <1>one-off payments</1> for a stated period. They do not renew automatically, and no card is stored for future charges.
terms.s6P2: Featured placement improves where you appear in search. It does not guarantee sales, enquiries, or any particular level of interest.
terms.s6P3: Prices may change; any change applies to new purchases, not to a period you have already paid for.
terms.s7Body: Flights, hotels, car hire and airport transfers are booked with <1>third-party partners</1>, on their sites and under their terms. Your contract for those bookings is with them, not with OAM. We earn a referral commission at no extra cost to you.
terms.s8P1: We work to keep OAM available and accurate, but we depend on banks, card processors and utility providers whose systems occasionally fail. We do not promise uninterrupted service.
terms.s8P2: Nothing here limits our liability for fraud, or for anything that cannot lawfully be limited under Nigerian law. <1>[TO CONFIRM — a lawyer should draft the liability and indemnity wording; a limitation clause written without advice tends to fail precisely when it is relied on.]</1>
terms.s9P1: You may close your account at any time; withdraw your balance first, as we may need to complete identity checks before releasing funds.
terms.s9P2: We may suspend or close an account where we reasonably suspect fraud, illegal use, or a serious breach of these terms. Where we do, we will return any balance that is rightfully yours, subject to any legal obligation preventing it.
terms.s10P1: We may update these terms. Material changes will be notified by email or in the app before they take effect.
terms.s10P2: These terms are governed by the laws of the <1>Federal Republic of Nigeria</1>. Please contact us first — most problems are settled quickly by email. <2>[TO CONFIRM — dispute resolution and jurisdiction wording.]</2>
